hypotheses.text: If CB Oscar Lindqvist had been 3 m closer to Marchetti, the chance to score would have fallen substantially — his proximity would likely have closed the shooting angle and reduced the scoring probability enough to make the goal unlikely.

If LB Dario Kesh had been 5 m closer to Marchetti, his pressure would have decreased Marchetti’s shooting space and comfort, lowering the chance to score and showing a preventing action the defense could reasonably have taken.
